title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

reports.title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

summary:
A former Costa Mesa police officer has pleaded guilty in court to contacting his mistress thousands of times through text messages, phone calls, and social media. On at least one day, he reached out to her more than 100 times. He also illegally accessed confidential law enforcement databases. He used those systems to track romantic rivals, an ex-girlfriend, and his wife, all people connected to his personal life rather than legitimate police work.

The former officer's guilty plea covers this misuse of police records and the repeated unwanted contact with his mistress. The case shows that he searched for information on several individuals he viewed as threats to his relationships. No sentencing date or specific penalty was mentioned in the report.
